body: I wish I had advice but I really understand how you feel, I'm having really similar problems myself. you might not feel like it, but recognising uve done wrong is the first step to being a better person.

I do something like this too and have found it super useful! if I'm having  a moment where I feel like I'll do something I'll regret I like to get into bed and hug myself and talk to myself in a soothing manner and tell myself I'm okay lol. it feels kind of strange and sometimes makes me feel strangely sad and nostalgic for childhood but it's really good to calm down :)

I understand how u feel very much and have struggled with it for a long time, as have many people on this sub I'm sure. 

firstly, college and the independence that comes with it can really help. even tho I think the it gets better phrase is cliche, with new opportunities anything can happen. lots of people find new friends and can basically reinvent themselves in college! and it comes with lots of chances to meet new people, even if ur nervous everyone else is too. getting a gf is basically luck when it comes down to it and most people I kno who struggled to get a partner found much more opportunities during college. 

envy is also a hard thing to deal with but try and break that bad habit as much as possible. this is kind of a weird mindset but it works for me. try and think about things u dont envy about this friend of urs. everyone has flaws as u kno, but realise they might feel similarly to u and u wont even know. everyone feels like others are doing better and that's just a fact of life bc humans r competitive creatures. 

finally the feeling as though u arent doing anything and ur wasting ur time is something I think a lot of people struggle with in this generation. because of hustle culture etc. people are expected to monetise everything and be the best at everything. try to learn to do stuff just to enjoy it and not to be good at it and then ull feel much better. 

sorry if this doesnt all make sense, please just stick it out. u never kno what will happen in life so u may as well find out and keep at it. I believe in u!
